spec.source: docs/design/2026-11-14-webapp-ui-ux-spec.md shared contract, R044 and approved Testing Decisions

findings.problem: The actual Suspense fallback renders a named status region and two aria-hidden skeletons, with zero h1s, while R044 opts out of the shell h1.
findings.requirement: Canonical shared spec: each persistent page has one semantic main heading; title ownership is staged atomically. F1/report also retains headings for pending arrivals.

evidence.fullName: retains the R044 task main heading during its actual server suspense fallback

findings.suggestedRootCorrection: Use a safe translated Work balance main heading in the loading composition; retain the named loading region and no old employee identity.

findings.problem: The loading/current-actor/current-organization mismatch branch renders only a status paragraph and no h1. It correctly hides old identity but leaves the converted route without a task heading.
findings.requirement: Canonical shared spec: one semantic main heading and honest scoped arrivals; keep task context without disclosing the prior employee.

evidence.fullName: retains a safe task main heading while the R044 server arrival mismatches current actor scope
failure: AssertionError: expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0

findings.suggestedRootCorrection: Keep a generic translated Work balance h1 beside the scope-loading status while retaining all actor/org mismatch gates.

preserved: Covered current/former identity, locale-aware directory return, signed balance and computed-through date; projection-null remains unavailable rather than zero.
Full immutable history retains kind/signed minutes/day/reason/actor/recorded instant and cancellation evidence; no total edit or external payment.
Opening replacement, payout bounds/conflicts, cancellation reasons and existing transaction/audit/time owners unchanged.
Refresh uses the real query owner and shared employee-prefix invalidation; stale database failures retain ledger/drafts and disable writes. Authorization refusal removes ledger/panels.

Scope gate compares authenticated user and active organization with server props; arrival key includes org/user/employee plus per-arrival query identity and query abort guard. Existing A→B→A/read-Activity cases pass.

Forms keep actual TanStack validation/typed defaults, per-request command lock, hidden/departed completion guard, failure recovery and pending close protection. Seven fresh additional lifecycle/legacy Dialog probes pass.
Existing settings and offboarding callers retain Dialog exports and final-payout initial day/amount/title payload; current suites and direct compatibility probe pass.

Independent current-member payroll grant/employee coverage stays separate from personnel/expense grants and manager/settings authority. Route refresh rechecks payroll coverage before the old authorized reader. Every public mutation still enters organizationAction/current-org authority and the insert-only store.

Seven authoritative domain owners are byte-equivalent after line-ending normalization to original baseline. UTC instants/captured offsets, employee-local dates, projection, closed-month and export meanings unchanged.
All prior heading opt-ins and both payroll directory/employee opt-ins are retained.

integrationFindings.problem: The prior directory test still expects the employee route to be shell-owned. R044 now legitimately adopts it. The test title also says only this route.

evidence.fullName: keeps the task heading during a pending directory read and adopts only this route
failure: AssertionError: expected true to be false // Object.is equality

integrationFindings.suggestedRootCorrection: Reconcile the title/employee expectation while keeping directory=true, employee=true and deeper descendants=false. Root explicitly reserved this correction for its dedicated branch.

inspectionLimits: No subagents, per explicit grant; standards and spec axes reviewed directly.
No new runtime, PostgreSQL, browser, provider or physical-device work; raw worker runtime evidence is inherited.
Full production/static generation, remote Tolgee catalogs/all locales, providers, wrapper/devices, true zoom and global transitions remain unpassed.
Held-request browser org/account A→B→A remains unpassed, distinct from the passing component and inherited PostgreSQL seams.
Root1726 archive validator remains nativeTarget:false; both before/after Equipment AuthorizationError is historical and not globally clean.
